title: Template report: fixed check labels, fourth outcome, full chain statuses
description:
In skills/ticks/references/agent-runner.md: the implementer template's report section, the "Warm-chain prompt variant", the "Chain protocol details" sentence about `DONE` per tick, and loop step 4g's chain-close wording. Also make the template's read-inputs order match the static-prefix order P1 documented (system prompt, repo instruction file, learnings head, rules).

The text must say:
- Check labels are fixed: the tick-gate command verbatim, `by-path run`, `planted fault`.
- There are four outcomes: add `went red, not from this change` (flaky or pre-existing; red on the baseline too) beside the existing three.
- The chain's per-tick status line is `<tick-id>: DONE | DONE_WITH_CONCERNS — … | NEEDS_CONTEXT — … | BLOCKED — …`.
- The orchestrator closes ticks marked DONE, and DONE_WITH_CONCERNS ones once their concerns are resolved. A chain stops at NEEDS_CONTEXT or BLOCKED; its completed prefix stays committed.

Shared vocabulary (verbatim across all three parallel chains, which do not see each other):
- Files: `.tick/learnings.md` is the always-read head (at most 4096 bytes: hard rules plus an index of the body's categories). `.tick/learnings-ref.md` is the looked-up body (Problem/Cause/Rule entries, at most 16384 bytes, at most 800 bytes per entry). The 800-byte entry limit applies to the body only. The engine owns the format; the project owns the content.
- Check labels in implementer reports: the tick-gate command verbatim, `by-path run`, `planted fault`.
- Check outcomes: `ran clean`, `went red and changed the code`, `went red, not from this change`, `not applicable`.
- Terms: "parallel warm-chains", "warm turn", "retire" (an implementer is retired after the final review).
- Existing section titles in agent-runner.md stay as they are. The gate names are "tick gate" and "wave gate", already defined.
Spec (source of truth): docs/thoughts/2026-11-12-lean-epics.md. Edit only skills/ticks/ (never an installed copy) unless your task names other files. Keep the engine's terse voice; criteria, not step lists.
acceptance_criteria:
- `grep -n 'went red, not from this change' skills/ticks/references/agent-runner.md` hits in both the template and the variant
- The literals `by-path run` and `planted fault` are present in the template
- The variant's status line names all four statuses
